name: PapaMap
subtitle: Changing tables for dads
promotionalText: About 26,000 changing tables in 49 countries from OpenStreetMap, with changes in minutes. Green means dad can get to it.
description:
PapaMap shows changing tables that dads can actually get to.

Green means both parents can reach the table. Red means it is in the ladies' room only. Grey means nobody has recorded yet which room it is in.

The data comes from OpenStreetMap, about 26,000 changing tables in 49 countries, refreshed every night.

"Nearest changing table" shows the closest table you can reach, with the distance. "Route" opens your navigation app, Apple Maps, Google Maps, Waze or Organic Maps.

On a grey pin the app asks "Which room is the changing table in?". Your answer goes straight to OpenStreetMap. You need an account there once, that takes a minute, after that it is a few seconds per pin. If the table is missing completely, add it with "Add place".

Filters for accessible and play corner. Dad view and mum view. Search for places and addresses. Save a city offline and the map works without a connection. Siri, a widget and a Control Center control show the nearest table without opening the app.

"My PapaMap" lists your answers, saved places and how much of your city is answered already.

The app collects no data. Your location stays on the phone.

playDescription:
PapaMap shows changing tables that dads can actually get to.

Green means both parents can reach the table. Red means it is in the ladies' room only. Grey means nobody has recorded yet which room it is in.

The data comes from OpenStreetMap, about 26,000 changing tables in 49 countries, refreshed every night.

"Nearest changing table" shows the closest table you can reach, with the distance. "Route" opens your maps app, for example Google Maps or Organic Maps.

On a grey pin the app asks "Which room is the changing table in?". Your answer goes straight to OpenStreetMap. You need an account there once, that takes a minute, after that it is a few seconds per pin. If the table is missing completely, add it with "Add place".

Filters for accessible and play corner. Dad view and mum view. Search for places and addresses. Save a city offline and the map works without a connection.

A home-screen widget shows the nearest table, and touching and holding the app icon opens the map right there.

"My PapaMap" lists your answers, saved places and how much of your city is answered already.

No ads, no tracking, no PapaMap account. Your location is only used to show the map around you and is never stored.
whatsNew:
Fixed in 1.3.1:
• The widget and Siri no longer measure from an old location (one older than 30 minutes is ignored), and they no longer say "1000 m" for a kilometre.
• Your answers in a place's card stay put when the map refreshes in the background.
• "Open now" uses the place's own local time, so it is right in other time zones too.
• Stronger contrast on buttons; the share icon is centred.
• The filter buttons work better with VoiceOver and Voice Control.
